title: Intermesh Territory
description: Sovereign spatial coordinates of an entity within Bitmap Territories. Territory is not ownership — it is stewardship.

parcel.description: Optional named parcel or sector within the territory

steward.description: Mesh ID of the sovereign steward of this territory

inscription_id.description: Ordinals inscription ID of the .bitmap asset

established_at.description: Unix timestamp when stewardship was established

coordinates.description: Optional spatial sub-coordinates within the territory
